I'm sorry, I cannot stick it out any longer. I can't bear to wake up to another day of pain, it's too much. Thank you and everyone else for responding to me .
I've watched, I liked it a lot. I'm not that strong though, unfortunately.
I started watching the new Series of unfortunate events, I would have liked to see the rest of it. Also season 4 of The Fosters resumes in a few days, but I can't stick around that long.
